    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)

  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let P := sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let Q := sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩)

  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let Δ (g : C_i) : Set Q := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let q (x : P) : Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
  let fib (y : Q) : Fin (2 ^ steps) → P :=
    qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := y)
  let idx (x : P) : Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
    pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x)
  have hq (x : P) : fib (q x) (idx x) = x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := q x)).mp rfl

  have hcard : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by

  have h_alg : (d_j - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_j, d_i]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i := by omega
    have h2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - ↑i := by omega
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hpos : 0 < d_i := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, d_i]
    omega
  have hle : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← h_alg]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw

    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.sub_lt_self hpos Nat.one_pos))
